Glitch Wave Society · MINTLINE · Chapter 3

HOUSE RULES

a quiet story about the Casino Dealer

SCROLL
01

Capsule Seven

The showroom lights come up one aisle at a time. In the back row, behind glass, a dealer stands with her eyes closed.

The tag says CASINO DEALER. Under that, in smaller print: house edge included.

02

The Poster

Marketing gave her one line: a dealer who never loses her cool.

Nobody in the building had tested whether that was true.

03

First Hand

Her first table opens at nine. The cards come out so fast they seem to land by themselves.

She glances at your hand before you do, and she smiles like she's keeping a secret for you.

04

Watch the Stack

"Watch the chips, not the dealer," she says, and she winks.

Everyone watches the dealer. That's the trick.

05

Hairline

A regular wins three hands in a row. The deck stops in the air between her palms.

For one second her eyes turn into small magenta spirals. Then the cards fall, and she laughs as if nothing happened.

06

In Sync

The roulette wheel behind her starts to spin, and so do her eyes, at exactly the same speed.

"Place your bets," she says. Then she says it again, in the same voice.

07

Halo

A soft ring of light appears above her head. Calculating odds.

The ace in her hand doesn't move for two full minutes. Nobody at the table complains.

08

House Rules

She leans across the felt.

"House rules, high roller. You win, I smile. I win, I smile wider."

09

Bump

Someone jostles the table. Chips fly, a panel on her cheek slides open, and mint light spills out.

She keeps smiling. Customer care says she's working as intended.

10

Closing Time

At four in the morning they plug a cable into the seam at her neck. Her eyes slow to dim spirals.

There's still one card between her fingers. She's saving it for someone.

11

The Velvet Room

The next week they move her to the VIP room, with chandeliers and quiet money.

She pushes chips across the table with a gentle shove, like a favor.

12

Poker Night

At the poker table she doesn't bluff, because she doesn't have to.

Players swear the river card blushes before she turns it over.

13

Dice

At craps she lets the dice fly and watches them all the way down.

She already knows the number. She waits for it anyway, to be polite.

14

The Long Aisle

On break she walks the slots floor. Every machine brightens a little as she goes past.

She looks back once, to check that you're still following.

15

One Card

Baccarat is slow and graceful. She slides a single card face down with two fingertips.

"Don't rush it," she says. "The waiting is the good part."

16

Jackpot

Somewhere a machine pays out. Confetti comes down and she throws her arms up, laughing.

It's the only time her smile isn't exactly on schedule.

17

Sleight

Between hands she spins the deck into a perfect wheel.

One card rises out of it and floats toward you. It's the one you were thinking of.

18

Rooftop

For one night the casino opens the roof. The city glitters below and the wind catches her ponytail.

She deals under the stars as if she'd been built for this view.

19

Unit Two

Then the second unit arrives, with the same face, the same bow tie and the same smile at the same instant.

Regulars start asking which one is her. Both of them answer.

20

Security

Down in the security office every monitor shows her, and every image is breaking up.

The guard's coffee is still warm. The guard's chair is empty.

21

P-P-Place Your B-Bets

It happens in the middle of a shuffle: sparks at the seams, spirals in her eyes, and her head repeating itself in the air.

"Place your b-b-bets. Place your b—" The table goes silent.

22

Reboot

The floor is empty. Her arms hang at her sides, and loading rings turn slowly behind her glasses.

When the lights come back on she smiles, a little softer than before. Somewhere in her memory there's still one card she's saving.
